Q1_what_to_build.answer: For each family with published examples, clone the target repo and run dotnet build on the .sln or .csproj at the repo root.

Q2_script_location.rationale: Standalone script callable from CI and locally. Does not import pipeline code.

Q3_output_format.answer: JSON report at workspace/verification/latest/monthly-build-regression-report.json with: per_family results (build_exit_code, stdout, stderr, pass/fail), overall verdict, timestamp.

Q4_ci_integration.answer: Add a new job 'regression-check' to monthly-package-refresh.yml that runs the validation script. Separate from generation job. No LLM, no publishing.

Q5_clone_strategy.answer: Shallow clone (depth=1) into temp directory. Clean up after build. Uses GITHUB_TOKEN for private repos.

Q6_dotnet_version.answer: Use .NET 8.0 (matches CI setup-dotnet version and published project target framework net8.0).

Q7_failure_handling.answer: Build failure is recorded as REGRESSED for that family. Script returns exit code 1 if any family fails, 0 if all pass. CI job uses continue-on-error: false.
Q7_failure_handling.rationale: CI should fail visibly on regression.

Q8_what_not_to_do.answer: No LLM generation. No example publishing. No metrics posting. No PR creation. Read-only clone and build only.

Q9_test_plan.answer: 3 tests: report schema validation, script module importability, simulated build result handling.

Q10_family_registry.answer: Script reads family list from merge-result evidence files (workspace/verification/latest/*-merge-result.json) to discover which repos have published examples.
